title: Quantization of measures in Carnot groups
summary: We study optimal quantization of probability measures on Carnot groups equipped with a left-invariant homogeneous distance. We prove two main results. First, we establish a Zador-type asymptotic formula for the quantization error: after the natural rescaling, the error converges as the number of centers tends to infinity, and the exponent is determined by the homogeneous dimension of the group.
